# Certificate — benzene · pipeline pin · -

benzene: the infrared spectrum of ΔH-network v1.3 (3 seeds) — B3LYP/6-31G* corrected toward ωB97X/6-31G* — with the error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction measured on molecules the network never saw; 0 of 30 bands are licensed: the version's harmonic positions ω are licensed for ring-ip, CH-stretch, CH-oop, other (decision 65) where a band's own position moved by no more than the licence line in the presentations tried (this molecule turned, mirrored or listed in another atom order), and for this molecule that licence is withheld — how far this molecule's bands move when it is turned, mirrored or listed in another order could not be measured (the result holds no own_spread.json: the pipeline writes it since 0.15, and python -m m08.own_spread measures an earlier result), so no band is licensed; the corrected positions are still printed — each band marked; at the coupled-cluster level not measured for this network version: the coupled-cluster reads (T3) were made on an earlier network (chain 34). The scaled B3LYP spectrum is shown as the baseline only. This molecule and the ΔH network: held out, hold-out (a) (A_8448043181): never trained on; the measured error includes it.

**Positions.** Positions are harmonic (ω): the anharmonic step was not applied — the result was computed by a pipeline version before the anharmonic step (0.11).

- c1ccccc1, C6H6, 12 atoms (C, H); the network's training set spans 6–40 atoms: inside

## How well the network is known (its product-error record and its evaluation records)

Against ωB97X/6-31G* (the DFT proxy: the network's ΔH is trained on ωB97X − B3LYP Hessians); two quantities, each under its name.

The licence reads the error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction (rms over the family's bands of the corrected band position's error against the higher level (cm⁻¹): the seeds' mean ΔH added to the B3LYP Hessian and diagonalised, each corrected band paired to its higher-level band by mode overlap and counted in the family of its B3LYP partner — what the pipeline prints; with the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over whole molecules).

definitions.coupling_ratio: rms of the predicted mode couplings' error over the rms of the couplings themselves; 0 = exact, 1 = no better than none
definitions.family: rms over the family's B3LYP modes of the first-order diagonal error of a seed's ΔH against the higher level, per seed, and the seeds' mean (cm⁻¹); families by module 05's rule (m05/learning_curve_layerA.molecule_features)
definitions.intensity_error: intensity-weighted rms of the relative height error per band, bands paired by the shape of the motion (eigenvector overlap); 0 = identical heights
definitions.product: rms over the family's bands of the corrected band position's error against the higher level (cm⁻¹): the seeds' mean ΔH added to the B3LYP Hessian and diagonalised, each corrected band paired to its higher-level band by mode overlap and counted in the family of its B3LYP partner — what the pipeline prints; with the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over whole molecules
definitions.spectrum_overlap: cosine similarity of the two Lorentzian-broadened spectra (FWHM 10 cm⁻¹, 500–3500 cm⁻¹); 1 = identical shape
